name: Dirk van der Meer
bio:
Dirk's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with go-karts in his father's garage. He pursued a degree in Electrical Engineering, specializing in embedded systems and control theory, before landing his first role at a small racing outfit. He quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating an uncanny ability to diagnose and resolve complex electrical issues under immense pressure. Dirk joined Blau Motorsport five years ago and has become an integral part of the team's electronics department.

Dirk is a perfectionist, known for his meticulous approach to every task. He insists on a thorough understanding of the entire system before implementing any changes, ensuring reliability and minimizing potential risks. He is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what is possible, constantly seeking innovative solutions to enhance the car's performance. He also enjoys mentoring junior engineers and helping them develop their skills.

Beyond the technical aspects, Dirk understands the importance of teamwork and collaboration. He actively seeks input from other members of the engineering team, fostering a culture of open communication and shared problem-solving. His ability to bridge the gap between theory and practice makes him a valuable asset to Blau Motorsport.
